"""Lifecycle and ordering tests with hand-computed expectations."""
import sys

sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/project')
from main import run
from modules.byte_program import hash_bytes

failures = 0


def check(name, got, want):
    global failures
    if got != want:
        failures += 1
        print('FAIL', name)
        print('  got ', str(got)[:600])
        print('  want', str(want)[:600])
    else:
        print('ok  ', name)


def document(cases, events=(), timeout=10, definitions=(), channels=()):
    return {'seed': 's', 'definitions': list(definitions), 'timeout_ms': timeout,
            'cases': list(cases), 'events': list(events), 'channels': list(channels)}


def case(name, frames, method='GET', target='/a', host='h'):
    return {'name': name, 'frames': frames,
            'expect': {'method': method, 'target': target, 'host': host}}


def headers(pairs, end=False):
    return {'Type': 'headers', 'data_to_transfered': [list(p) for p in pairs],
            'End_Stream': end}


def data(text, end=False):
    return {'Type': 'data', 'data_to_transfered': text, 'End_Stream': end}


def sleep(ms):
    return {'Type': 'sleep', 'Time_to_Stop': ms}


def ehat(at, stream, fields, end):
    return {'at': at, 'kind': 'headers', 'stream': stream,
            'fields': [list(p) for p in fields], 'end': end}


def edata(at, stream, text, end):
    return {'at': at, 'kind': 'data', 'stream': stream, 'data': text, 'end': end}


def close(at):
    return {'at': at, 'kind': 'close'}


def summary(out, index=0):
    row = out['cases'][index]
    return (row['state'], row['at'], row['frames'], row['request_frames'],
            row['payload_bytes'], row['sent']['n'], row['received']['n'],
            row['response_frames'], row['response_body']['n'], row['stream'])


# L2/L3: response while paused, completed at send-finish
out = run(document([case('a', [sleep(5), headers([('x', 'y')], True)])],
                   [ehat(5, 0, [(':status', '200')], True)], timeout=7))
check('response before pause completion', summary(out),
      ('ok', 5, 1, 1, 3, 8 + 4 + 1 + 8 + 8 + 32 + 1, 13 + 8 + (8 + 8 + 8 + 3) + 1, 1, 0, 0))
out = run(document([case('a', [sleep(5), headers([('x', 'y')], True)])],
                   [ehat(6, 0, [(':status', '200')], True)], timeout=7))
check('response after send finish', summary(out), ('ok', 6, 1, 1, 3, 50, 40, 1, 0, 0))

# L5: timeout exactly tied with a response end -> ok wins
out = run(document([case('a', [headers([('x', 'y')], True)])],
                   [ehat(10, 0, [], True)], timeout=10))
check('tied response beats timeout', summary(out), ('ok', 10, 1, 1, 3, 31, 21, 1, 0, 0))

# L4: plain timeout
out = run(document([case('a', [headers([('x', 'y')], True)])], [], timeout=10))
check('timeout', summary(out), ('timeout', 10, 1, 1, 3, 31, 0, 0, 0, 0))

# L6: frame after request end
out = run(document([case('a', [headers([('x', 'y')], True), headers([('z', 'w')])])],
                   [ehat(1, 0, [], True)]))
check('send error', summary(out), ('send_error', 0, 1, 1, 3, 31, 21, 1, 0, 0))

# L7: sleep after end, then a frame
out = run(document([case('a', [headers([('x', 'y')], True), sleep(4), data('q')])],
                   []))
check('sleep after end then data', summary(out), ('send_error', 4, 1, 1, 3, 31, 0, 0, 0, 0))

# L8: datagram does not close the request
out = run(document([case('a', [{'Type': 'datagram', 'data_to_transfered': 'abcd'},
                              headers([('x', 'y')], True)])], [ehat(2, 0, [], True)]))
check('datagram then headers', summary(out), ('ok', 2, 2, 1, 7, 13 + 8 + 4 + 1 + 31 - 13, 21, 1, 0, 0))

# L21: close stops a paused sender
out = run(document([case('a', [sleep(5), headers([('x', 'y')], True)])], [close(2)]))
check('close while paused', summary(out), ('closed', 2, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0))

# L22: close while waiting
out = run(document([case('a', [headers([('x', 'y')], True)])], [close(3)]))
check('close while waiting', summary(out), ('closed', 3, 1, 1, 3, 31, 0, 0, 0, 0))

# L10: close cannot replace a terminal result
out = run(document([case('a', [headers([('x', 'y')], True)]), case('b', [headers([], True)])],
                   [ehat(1, 0, [], True), close(2)]))
check('close after terminal', [summary(out, 0)[:2], summary(out, 1)[:2],
                              out['cases'][1]['state']],
      [['ok', 1], ['closed', 2], 'closed'])

# L18: close tied with timeout -> close wins (kind 0 before kind 2)
out = run(document([case('a', [headers([('x', 'y')], True)])], [close(10)], timeout=10))
check('close beats timeout', summary(out)[:2], ('closed', 10))

# L12/L13: unknown stream, terminal stream, double end
out = run(document([case('a', [headers([('x', 'y')], True)])],
                   [ehat(1, 8, [('q', 'r')], True), edata(2, 0, 'abc', False),
                    edata(3, 0, 'de', True), edata(4, 0, 'ignored', True)]))
check('retained responses', summary(out), ('ok', 3, 1, 1, 3, 31, 21 + 34, 2, 5, 0))

# L14: no frames at all
out = run(document([case('a', [])], [ehat(3, 0, [], True)]))
check('no frames then response', summary(out), ('ok', 3, 0, 0, 0, 0, 21, 1, 0, 0))
out = run(document([case('a', [])], [], timeout=4))
check('no frames timeout', summary(out), ('timeout', 4, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0))

# L16: array order at equal times
out = run(document([case('a', [headers([], True)])],
                   [edata(5, 0, 'x', False), ehat(5, 0, [], True), edata(5, 0, 'y', True)]))
check('equal time array order', summary(out), ('ok', 5, 1, 1, 0, 22, 21 + 32, 2, 1, 0))

# events out of order in the array
out = run(document([case('a', [headers([], True)])],
                   [edata(9, 0, 'z', True), edata(2, 0, 'a', False)]))
check('unordered events', summary(out), ('ok', 9, 1, 1, 0, 22, 32 + 32, 2, 2, 0))

# multiple cases: streams 4*i, independent state
out = run(document([case('a', [headers([('x', 'y')], True)]),
                    case('b', [sleep(1), data('qq', True)]),
                    case('c', [])],
                   [ehat(1, 4, [], True), edata(2, 0, 'r', False)]))
check('three cases', [summary(out, i) for i in range(3)],
      [('ok', 2, 1, 1, 3, 31, 32, 1, 1, 0),
       ('ok', 1, 1, 1, 2, 8 + 4 + 1 + 8 + 2 + 1, 21, 1, 0, 4),
       ('timeout', 10, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 8)])

# receipt time uses the emission time
out = run(document([case('a', [sleep(3), data('abc', True), sleep(2), data('d', True)])], []))
check('send error at second data', summary(out)[:2], ('send_error', 3))

# zero pause yields to same-time external events
out = run(document([case('a', [sleep(0), headers([('x', 'y')], True)])],
                   [ehat(0, 0, [(':status', '2')], True)]))
check('zero pause yield', summary(out), ('ok', 0, 1, 1, 3, 31, 20, 1, 0, 0))

print('lifecycle: %d failures' % failures)
sys.exit(1 if failures else 0)
PYEOF
